agenda_items.section: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Mayor Osborne called the regular September 20, 2011 City Council meeting to order at 6:00 p.m. in Council Chambers.

agenda_items.section: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: COLORADO COMPANIES TO WATCH DECLARATION.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Mayor Osborne read a declaration honoring the Boulder recipients of the Colorado Companies to Watch Awards and declared October 1 through 31 as Colorado Companies To Watch Month.

agenda_items.title: OPEN COMMENT and COUNCIL/STAFF RESPONSE
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Several Council Members requested that staff develop an email list to help notify residents of any Council discussions on the item and any associated materials.

agenda_items.title: CONSENT AGENDA:
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council Member Gray moved, seconded by Wilson to approve Consent agenda item 3B with item 3A removed from the agenda.

agenda_items.title: INTRODUCTION, FIRST READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ORDER PUBLISHED BY TITLE ONLY AN ORDINANCE AMENDING CHAPTER 9-3 "OVERLAY DISTRICTS" AND SECTION 9-16-1 "DEFINITIONS," B.R.C. 1981 TO AMEND FLOODPLAIN REGULATIONS IN ORDER TO PROTECT CRITICAL FACILITIES AND MOBILE POPULATIONS IN THE 500- AND 100-YEAR FLOODPLAINS.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: This item was pulled from the agenda and will be rescheduled at a later date.

agenda_items.title: INTRODUCTION, FIRST READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ORDER PUBLISHED BY TITLE ONLY AN ORDINANCE REPEALING AND RE-ENACTING SECTION 11-1-19, "WATER AND DITCH RIGHTS," B.R.C. 1981, TO ADDRESS AGREEMENTS FOR RIGHT OF FIRST REFUSAL, PURCHASE AND SALE OF WATER OR DITCH RIGHTS AND RESULTING ADJUSTMENT OF WATER BUDGET.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council Member Gray moved, seconded by Wilson to approve Consent agenda item 3B with item 3A removed from the agenda.

agenda_items.title: POTENTIAL CALL- UP CHECK IN:
agenda_items.outcome_summary: No interest was expressed.

agenda_items.title: PUBLIC HEARINGS:
SECOND READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ADOPT ORDINANCE No. 7813 AMENDING TITLE 9, LAND USE CODE, B.R.C. 1981:
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council Member Becker moved, seconded by Karakehian to adopt Ordinance No. 7813 section 9-8-2, Table 8-2 "Floor Area Ratio Additions" adding a floor area addition for commercial uses in the DT-5 zone district.

agenda_items.title: SECTION 9-7-1 TABLE 7-1 “FORM AND BULK STANDARDS” ADDING A 65-FOOT SUPPLEMENTAL SETBACK FOR ZONE DISTRICTS DOWNTOWN-5 (DT-5) AND PUBLIC (P) ALONG CANYON BLVD. FROM 9 TH TO 16 TH STREETS.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council Member Gray moved, seconded by Appelbaum to amend ordinance No. 7813 to include 9-7-1, Table 7-1 "Form and Bulk Standards" adding a 65 foot supplemental setback for zone districts Downtown 5 (DT-5) and Public (P) along Canyon Boulevard from 9th to 16th Streets.

agenda_items.title: SECTION 9-8-2 TABLE 8-2 “FLOOR AREA RATIO ADDITIONS” ADDING A FLOOR AREA ADDITION FOR COMMERCIAL USES IN THE DT-5 ZONE DISTRICT.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council Member Becker moved, seconded by Karakehian to adopt Ordinance No. 7813 section 9-8-2, Table 8-2 "Floor Area Ratio Additions" adding a floor area addition for commercial uses in the DT-5 zone district.

agenda_items.title: SECOND READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ADOPT ORDINANCE NO. 7814 TO AMEND PROVISIONS OF CHAPTER 6-14 “MEDICAL MARIJUANA,” B.R.C. 1981.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council Member Osborne moved, seconded by Appelbaum to adopt Ordinance No. 7814 to amend provisions of Chapter 6-14 "Medical Marijuana," B.R.C. 1981.

agenda_items.title: MATTERS FROM THE CITY MANAGER:
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council agreed that further discussion was desired and the item was continued to a study session at 6 p.m.

agenda_items.title: MOTION TO RECEIVE THE 2010-2012 AFFORDABLE HOUSING TASK FORCE REPORT.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council agreed that further discussion was desired and the item was continued to a study session at 6 p.m.

agenda_items.title: MATTERS FROM THE CITY ATTORNEY:
agenda_items.outcome_summary: None.

agenda_items.section: MATTERS FROM MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF COUNCIL
agenda_items.title: MATTERS FROM MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF COUNCIL:
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council Members Appelbaum and Ageton volunteered to be on the Council Retreat Committee.

agenda_items.section: MATTERS FROM MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF COUNCIL
agenda_items.title: POTENTIAL CALL-UPS:
agenda_items.outcome_summary: No action was taken on this item.

agenda_items.title: CONCEPTUAL LANDMARK ALTERATION CERTIFICATE FOR THE GENERAL LOCATION, MASS, SCALE, AND HEIGHT OF THE PROPOSED NEW BUILDING ON 1048 PEARL STREET AND 1023 WALNUT AVENUE IN THE DOWNTOWN HISTORIC DISTRICT (DAILY CAMERA BUILDING), PER SECTION 9-11-8 OF THE BOULDER REVISED CODE (HIS2011-00139) INFORMATION PACKET DATE: SEPTEMBER 14, 2011. LAST OPPORTUNITY FOR CALL-UP IS SEPTEMBER 20, 2011. CONDITIONALLY APPROVED BY THE LANDMARKS BOARD 5-0.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: No action was taken on this item.

agenda_items.section: MATTERS FROM MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF COUNCIL
agenda_items.title: 2011 MID-YEAR APPOINTMENTS TO BOARDS AND COMMISSIONS.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council Member Wilson moved, seconded by Morzel to ratify the appointments to Boards and Commissions.

agenda_items.title: PUBLIC COMMENT ON MATTERS:
agenda_items.outcome_summary: None.

agenda_items.title: FINAL DECISIONS ON MATTERS: Action on motions made under Matters.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried 8:0, Becker Absent.

agenda_items.title: ADJOURNMENT
agenda_items.outcome_summary: There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 11:58 P.M.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Gray moved, seconded by Wilson to approve Consent agenda item 3B with item 3A removed from the agenda.

Council Member Becker moved, seconded by Karakehian to adopt Ordinance No. 7813 section 9-8-2, Table 8-2 "Floor Area Ratio Additions" adding a floor area addition for commercial uses in the DT-5 zone district.

Council Member Gray moved, seconded by Appelbaum to amend ordinance No. 7813 to include 9-7-1, Table 7-1 "Form and Bulk Standards" adding a 65 foot supplemental setback for zone districts Downtown 5 (DT-5) and Public (P) along Canyon Boulevard from 9th to 16th Streets.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 5:4; Ageton, Becker, Karakehian and Wilson opposed.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Morzel moved, seconded by Ageton to suspend the rules and continue the meeting at 10:35 p.m.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7:1; Karakehian opposed, Becker absent.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Osborne moved, seconded by Appelbaum to adopt Ordinance No. 7814 to amend provisions of Chapter 6-14 "Medical Marijuana," B.R.C. 1981.
Council Member Ageton moved, seconded by Wilson to suspend the rules and continue the meeting at 11:00 p.m.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7:1; Karakehian opposed, Becker absent.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Wilson moved, seconded by Morzel to ratify the appointments to Boards and Commissions.
There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 11:58 P.M.
